problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate its fleet to deliver nine distinct categories of cargo, each requiring passage through nine sequential handling stages.  
The revenue generated per ton of each cargo category is as follows:  
* For Cargo Alpha, revenue is 18.519 per ton  
* For Cargo Beta, revenue is 10.853 per ton  
* For Cargo Gamma, revenue is 17.367 per ton  
* For Cargo Delta, revenue is 18.036 per ton  
* For Cargo Epsilon, revenue is 19.326 per ton  
* For Cargo Zeta, revenue is 12.206 per ton  
* For Cargo Eta, revenue is 18.39 per ton  
* For Cargo Theta, revenue is 17.35 per ton  
* For Cargo Iota, revenue is 12.044 per ton  

The handling duration required per ton for each stage is detailed below:  
* For Cargo Alpha, Stage 1 consumes 1.492 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.443 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.54 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.913 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.69 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.821 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.636 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 0.722 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 1.098 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Beta, Stage 1 consumes 0.915 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.993 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.634 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.716 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.654 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.904 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.447 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.094 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 1.895 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Gamma, Stage 1 consumes 0.268 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.834 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.536 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.564 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.726 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.755 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.387 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 0.687 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 0.471 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Delta, Stage 1 consumes 0.577 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.435 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.825 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.772 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.267 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.487 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.389 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.996 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 0.654 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Epsilon, Stage 1 consumes 0.716 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.534 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.702 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.9 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.868 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.945 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.802 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.272 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 1.144 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Zeta, Stage 1 consumes 0.669 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.394 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.198 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.203 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.302 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.815 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.963 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.071 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 0.772 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Eta, Stage 1 consumes 1.405 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.642 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.415 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.959 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.402 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.267 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.77 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.767 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 1.182 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Theta, Stage 1 consumes 1.798 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.652 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.47 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.217 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.896 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.857 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.251 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.659 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 1.129 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Iota, Stage 1 consumes 1.957 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.7 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.654 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.918 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.898 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.484 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.389 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.197 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 0.58 (ton-hours)  

The cumulative handling duration allocated to each stage cannot surpass its available capacity:  
* Stage 1’s total handling duration must not exceed 151.494 hours  
* Stage 2’s total handling duration must not exceed 167.899 hours  
* Stage 3’s total handling duration must not exceed 206.872 hours  
* Stage 4’s total handling duration must not exceed 218.171 hours  
* Stage 5’s total handling duration must not exceed 166.291 hours  
* Stage 6’s total handling duration must not exceed 169.904 hours  
* Stage 7’s total handling duration must not exceed 138.505 hours  
* Stage 8’s total handling duration must not exceed 293.597 hours  
* Stage 9’s total handling duration must not exceed 141.288 hours  

Provided that the cumulative duration for each handling stage—Stage 1 through Stage 9—remains within its respective available time, determine the optimal tonnage allocation for each cargo category to maximize total revenue.
